d: South Africa's ruling African National Congress has suffered its worst-ever election result, securing just 31 percent of the vote in the latest municipal elections. The party that ended apartheid under Nelson Mandela once dominated South African politics. But poor public services, rising unemployment, and corruption allegations have eroded public support. Why are voters turning away from Nelson Mandela's party? And can it rebuild its support before the 2029 national elections? Palki Sharma tells you.
